required_findings: R01 stale closed wrapper can authorize descriptor numbers reused by a fresh retained owner
R02 close error aborts remaining ancestor cleanup and can discard still-open descriptor accounting
required_contract: Explicit wrapper and descriptor ownership/lifecycle; once close starts saved handles grant no read/seek/check/lease/compose/adopt authority
At most one operational close attempt per owned descriptor generation; continue closing independent remaining owned descriptors after failure
Retain uncertain close state without assuming OS closure, blind numeric retry, authority over reused handles or healthy-zero claims
Preserve original composition or construction failure as primary with cleanup failures attached
Keep unchanged original controls and corrected raw results; any test-cleanup adaptation must be separate and leave behavioral assertions intact
Synthetic known-fault cleanup or process-exit containment must be distinct from resolution of an actual OS ambiguous close
All source/tool/input/output identities, bounded child commands, finite registry/quarantine state and scratch cleanup recorded
